statement.p: If possible, choose k so that the following function is continuous on any interval: f(x)= \begin{cases} \frac{8x^{3}-16x^{2}}{x-2}\quad \amp x \ne 2 \\ k \amp x = 2. \end{cases}

p.em: (If no k will make the function continuous, enter none)

static.solution:
k, the function is continuous on any interval that does not contain x=2.
Since 8 x^{3} - 16 x^{2} = 8 x^{2}(x - 2), we can cancel (x-2) provided x\ne 2, giving
f(x) = \frac{8x^{3}-16x^{2}}{x-2} = 8 x^{2},\quad\quad x\ne 2. Thus, if we pick k = 8 (2)^{2} = 32, the function is continuous.
